name: Caddy Shed Golf
statusNote: Shipped concept/pitch package. Dressed to the client's brand, not the house style — and unusually, offers three complete design directions so the client picks the brand feel, not just a yes/no.
oneLiner: A pitch package for a family-owned custom-fit golf equipment shop on Portage Avenue: three parallel full design directions plus a printable proposal.
stack: Google Fonts CDN, prefers-reduced-motion handled globally

components.name: index.html
components.desc: Hub/chooser page — a 3-card grid linking to each direction, plus links to the proposal and the original concept

components.name: premium-heritage.html
components.desc: Direction 01: refined editorial look, deep green and brass, serif display type

components.name: modern-sport.html
components.desc: Direction 02: bold dark performance brand with an animated JS stat counter and a sticky Book-a-Fitting CTA

components.name: local-warm.html
components.desc: Direction 03: friendly family tone, warm cream/honey palette, live JS open/closed status pill computed from the current time

components.name: original-concept.html
components.desc: The first single-page draft the three directions were derived from

dataFlow: The hub page routes to three parallel, independent full sites — same content sections, distinct visual treatments.
Each direction is internally a single-page site with anchor-scroll nav.
CTAs are tel: click-to-call, hours tables, and a sticky Book-a-Fitting anchor on the sport direction — no live booking or contact form anywhere in the package.
integrations: Google Fonts (Playfair Display, Work Sans, Barlow Condensed)
Unsplash stock hero photography on the hub
No CMS, backend, payment, or booking system
decisions: The only pitch of the four offering a genuine A/B/C design choice — explicitly pitched as pick-your-favourite, deferring the design decision to the client.
Content held constant across all three directions to isolate which one feels like the shop as a pure branding question.
Each direction handles hours differently — static table, animated counter, or a live open/closed computation.
prefers-reduced-motion respected across the whole package.
